content: We tokenize English using the provided tokenizer from pre-trained models. For target languages, we use fastBPE to learn 30,000 BPE codes and 50,000 codes when transferring from BERT and RoBERTa respectively. We truncate the BPE vocabulary of foreign languages to match the size of the English vocabulary in the source models. Precisely, the size of foreign vocabulary is set to 32,000 when transferring from BERT and 50,000 when transferring from RoBERTa.
